purpose: Unpatched W1L1 ascent control aimed at the authored descriptor structures near x=1040..1168; tests whether a jump begun before that corridor reaches the statically identified blocked-ascent predecessor.

method.input: KBD_right sampled for 30 guest frames; KBD_right+KBD_space begins at sample 23, after the baseline reaches x=1029

observations.target_structure_crossing: The jump begins before the authored x=1040..1168 structure and reaches x=1074,y=321 while in negative mode. The sampled route then leaves the negative-mode path without reaching 4368.
observations.mode_sequence: The sampled ascent enters mode -1 at x=1074 and the next sampled callback is mode +1 at x=1120; no blocked-ascent response or landing response is observed in the watched addresses.

confirmed: The unpatched route can initiate a jump before the authored x=1040..1168 corridor and reach the 01F7:4323 negative-mode entry.
This sampled route does not reach the statically identified 01F7:4368 blocked-ascent predecessor.
The trace does not justify a floor, ceiling, or one-way semantic name for descriptor bits 0x20 or 0x40.
still_open: A natural authored ceiling trajectory that enters 4326 or 4368.
conclusion.evidence_policy: Retain as a natural ascent negative control; do not promote the static blocked-ascent response or rename descriptor bits from this route.
